claims: Artemis II launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
Artemis II launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The crew of Artemis II successfully completed a 10-day flight around the moon.
The crew of Artemis II splashed down on April 10, 2026.
The launch vehicle for Artemis II was the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The crew of Artemis II was Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The mission goal of Artemis II was the first crewed flyby of the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II was the first crewed flight of the Artemis program.
The Artemis program had a previous uncrewed test flight before Artemis II.
